visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed, 60vh (min 360px) on mobile, 50vh >= 768px, 40vh >= 992px; black background, flex-centred content.
visualCharacteristics.image: Photo at 50% opacity, absolute, full height, object-position 68% 25%; full width >= 992px. Eager LCP image (fetchpriority high).
visualCharacteristics.text: Centred white text box (padding 10px; 2vw and max-width 1200px >= 768px). h1 40px/1.1 weight 400; p 16px/1.65.
visualCharacteristics.button: Outline CTA: transparent, 1px solid #fff, radius 2px, padding 13px 20px, 13.5px/500; hover background #0065a7; transition .3s.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top hero with a dimmed photo and a centred heading, intro and CTA.

cells: text (richtext): h1, paragraph(s), paragraph holding a single CTA link

contentPattern.structure: Image row then rich-text row. Any paragraph holding only one link (plain, bold/italic or already a button) renders as the outline button.

reuseGuidance: Use for mybeckman.in page heroes with a dimmed full-width photo and centred white text. CTA may be an in-page anchor (e.g. #get-in-touch).
